2610.05872.title: Off-Policy Merging Beats On-Policy Self-Distillation for Continual Learning
2610.05872.paper_summary: A long-standing goal of AI is a model that can continually learn and improve itself. On post-trained models, supervised finetuning (SFT) on new data often causes poor generalization and catastrophic forgetting. As such, the conventional wisdom is that on-policy training is a prerequisite for continual learning. In practice, however, data containing new knowledge or capabilities are often off-policy. While methods such as on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) try to bridge this gap by converting off-policy data into on-policy signal, they have been shown to cause reasoning collapse. In this paper, we show that off-policy merging beats OPSD for continual learning. We first show that SFT learns a useful signal from new data, but naively applying its update interferes with existing capabilities. We reduce this interference with a simple recipe we term grafting, which changes where the update is learned and how it is applied: (1) learning the update on an earlier donor checkpoint, ideally even before the end of pretraining, and applying the weight update to the post-trained model; (2) scaling the weight update, equivalent to a form of model merging; and (3) optionally, masking the most sensitive update directions when the new data distribution is far from the post-trained model. Across continual learning settings including (1) distilling from expert traces, (2) self-improvement with STaR and Pedagogical RL, and (3) injecting knowledge after pretraining cutoff, grafting Pareto-dominates both SFT and OPSD in new-task and old-task performance, while avoiding expensive on-policy sampling. Therefore, our work challenges on-policy training as a necessity for continual learning on RL-trained models.
2610.05872.paper_summary_zh: 一個長期以來的人工智慧目標是建立一個能夠不斷學習和自我改進的模型。在後訓練模型上，對新數據進行監督微調（SFT）往往會導致較差的泛化能力和災難性遺忘。因此，傳統觀念認為，策略內訓練是持續學習的前提。然而，在實踐中，包含新知識或能力的數據往往是策略外的。雖然像策略內自我蒸餾（OPSD）這樣的方法試圖通過將策略外數據轉換為策略內信號來彌補這一差距，但已被證明會導致推理崩潰。在本文中，我們顯示策略外合併在持續學習上超越了OPSD。我們首先展示SFT從新數據中學習到有用的信號，但天真地應用其更新會干擾現有能力。我們用一個簡單的配方來減少這種干擾，我們稱之為嫁接，這改變了更新的學習位置和應用方式：（1）在較早的捐贈檢查點上學習更新，理想情況下甚至在預訓練結束之前，並將權重更新應用於後訓練模型；（2）縮放權重更新，相當於一種模型合併的形式；以及（3）可選地，在新數據分佈遠離後訓練模型時，屏蔽最敏感的更新方向。在包括（1）從專家痕跡中蒸餾，（2）使用STaR和教學強化學習進行自我改進，以及（3）在預訓練截止後注入知識的持續學習設置中，嫁接在新任務和舊任務的表現上優於SFT和OPSD，同時避免昂貴的策略內取樣。因此，我們的工作挑戰了將策略內訓練視為強化學習訓練模型持續學習的必要性。
